title: Apple fans are raging that the new MacBook Pro has an unreliable keyboard - so I wrote this article with one to show you how bad it can be (AAPL)
text: Apple fans are raging that the new MacBook Pro has an unreliable keyboard — so I wrote this article with one to show you how bad it can be (AAPL) By Antonio Villas-Boas May 19, 2018, 10:00 am 86 pts On Wednesday, the "G" key on my 15-inch 2016 MacBook Pro — a model sporting the newest butterfly keyboard design — started acting up for the second time since I bought it. It doesn't work unless I press very hard on the key. Several other Mac owners have reported a similar issue with their…
